Case reference: 2016030649.CaseDesc: Kean Luo was originally from Malaysia, but relocated to the United States to attend school and begin his career. He relocated to Winnipeg, Manitoba on March 2, 2016, for professional reasons. Concerns were raised by friends and family when Kean was not available to receive calls or messages for an extended period of time. However, on April 2, 2016, police spoke with Kean at a local hotel in Kenora, Ontario. He stated that he was not considering ending his own life, but was experiencing stress and missing his family. His vehicle was subsequently discovered parked on the shoulder of the highway on the Sergeant Thomas Cooper Bridge (Kenora). All mobile phone and banking activity has since ceased.

Case reference: 2016060399.CaseDesc: On October 3, 1975, the skeletal remains of a male were found in the brush on Sparrow Lake Road (Lot 23 Con 14) in Orillia. His post-mortem length was recorded as being between 5'8"-5'9" however; this measurement may not represent his actual living height due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy.  A pair of nail clippers was also found nearby. His death is estimated to have occurred in the spring or summer prior.

Teeth: No dental work, missing a few teeth in upper jaw.

Shoes: Brown leather clog-type shoes with a raised Cuban heel, size 7-8
Tie: Red, white, and blue material with curved design - possibly a necktie or head band
Underwear: White, Undershirt with label, partial initials "MP" followed by "LAN", beneath these "PETTIN"

Case reference: 2009004999.CaseDesc: At the time of her disappearance, Dawn Carisse was a patient of the North Bay Psychiatric Hospital. She is generally very pleasant though suffers from short term memory loss due to cardiac arrest several years earlier.  Dawn always spoke of leaving the hospital and going to where she believed her family would be. Her family was in the Kirkland Lake area and then moved to Sudbury. She was aware of both, and her possible destinations were Kirkland Lake or Sudbury. She was last seen on Highway 11 North, in North Bay, Ontario.

Hair: Brown, Curly, Parted in centre, short bangs
Dress: Maroon, Pink, Long dress with faint white flowers, short sleeves and front buttons.
Luggage: May have had a dark duffle bag in her possession.

Case reference: 2014005271.CaseDesc: On May 23, 2009, Fanzheng Meng was seen for the last time at Britannia Park and Beach in Ottawa, Ontario. Fanzheng and another man had been aboard an inflatable raft on the Ottawa River. The two men did not return to the shore and the deflated raft was subsequently located.

Case reference: 2014002895.CaseDesc: Pierre Merasty was raised in the Lynn Lake area of Manitoba and resided there until November 1994, when he relocated to Winnipeg.  He resided with family and friends for a period prior to relocating to a residence in the downtown area of Winnipeg.  Following the move, no further contact was had with him.  Pierre was known to frequent the Main Street bars and would usually walk anywhere he had to go.

Case reference: 2006013799.CaseDesc:
Katherine May Wilson was last seen on October 20, 1970, walking along Harvey Kirkland Road, in Kirkland Lake, Ontario. Extensive searches have failed to locate her.
Barry Manion was arrested on January 6, 2009, and pled guilty to murder on March 11, 2009.  He was sentenced to life in prison for her murder. Katherine's body has never been recovered.

Shirt: Red, Sweater, Worn underneath the blue sweater
